findings.evidence: Kiosk console contains an error: 'The report-only Content Security Policy was delivered via a <meta> element, which is disallowed. The policy has been ignored.' Source: http://127.0.0.1:8000/kiosk/idle line 22. This means the kiosk surface ships a CSP-report-only meta tag that the browser refuses, so CSP enforcement and reporting on the kiosk are entirely silently disabled. Combined with D-006 fixing the report endpoint storm, CSP signal on kiosk is now structurally lost.
findings.fix_hint: Move the CSP report-only directive from a `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only" …>` tag in the kiosk Blade template to a real HTTP response header (e.g. `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: …` set by Laravel middleware or the web server). The `report-uri` directive is not allowed in <meta>, browsers will keep ignoring it. Audit other surfaces (admin/POS) for the same anti-pattern.

findings.evidence: The kiosk surface in run-2 renders /kiosk/idle (Bienvenue !, Sur place, À emporter, FoodKing crown logo). DOM shows 9 `product-card` references but ZERO 'Sprite' substring matches. The cascade observation on kiosk is therefore inconclusive — we cannot verify Sprite is actually rendered as épuisé on the borne catalog because the kiosk never reaches it. Run-1 D-001 is fixed (no 429), but the cascade cannot be visually confirmed on kiosk without further navigation.

verdict: AMBER — major run-1 P0s (D-001 kiosk 429, D-003 POS rupture silent, D-005 cashier 403, D-006 csp-report storm, D-007 raw axios, D-008 first-paint 400s) are PASS. The owner's critical question is now answered YES on POS: a real cashier sees a red alert banner with role=alert + aria-live='Article indisponible : Sprite 33cl' the moment the cascade lands. D-002 is only PARTIALLY resolved: the visible reconnect banner is gated in local env, but the WS path is still REFUSED on every state and the spec still captures the rupture via `posPage.goto('/admin/pos')` reload — meaning real-time-sync via AvailabilityChannel is still unverified. D-004 'Affichering' i18n leak persists. New finding D2-001: kiosk's CSP report-only is delivered via a `<meta>` tag and silently ignored by the browser, so CSP reporting on kiosk is structurally dead. New finding D2-002: kiosk never advances past /kiosk/idle in this run, so cascade visibility on borne remains indirect. Aria-label on the rupture tile is still misleading. Convergence: GO on the user-visible cascade silent-failure; HOLD on real-time WS verification + admin i18n + kiosk catalog reachability before declaring iter15 fully green.
answer_to_owner_question: YES on POS, partial on kiosk. The POS rupture cascade now provides visible, accessible feedback: a red banner at the top of the shell with `role="alert"`, `aria-live="polite"`, copy 'Article indisponible : Sprite 33cl', a dismiss button, and clear visual styling (red on light-red bg). A real cashier would absolutely notice it. The Sprite tile also flips to `is-unavailable` with the 'Épuisé' overlay. CAVEAT: this run was captured AFTER `posPage.goto('/admin/pos')` reload — the websocket connection to :6001 is still refused on every state, so we cannot prove the same banner appears via AvailabilityChannel push without a navigation. In a real restaurant where the cashier never reloads, the banner only fires if the WS path actually delivers — that is still unverified end-to-end. Block iter15 sign-off until WS broadcast is asserted on a non-reloading POS context.
